source.programme: Seabird Monitoring Programme (SMP), Britain and Ireland

scientific_role: Prospective external test of breeding-component contraction outside penguins if structural eligibility is sufficient.

forbidden_before_gate_freeze: any abundance or concentration effect size

hierarchy.primary_component: SMP SiteCode counted as Whole Colony. SMP Sites are defined long-term monitoring sections with unique codes and are intended to preserve constancy/comparability across survey years.
hierarchy.secondary_component_route: Explicit SMP PlotName nested within one SMP Site may be audited separately if plot-level colony-count data are supplied. It cannot be mixed with the primary MasterSite > Site analysis.
hierarchy.parent_aggregate_rule: A MasterSite aggregate must never be included as a component together with its constituent SMP Sites.
hierarchy.partial_count_rule: Primary Site components require Whole Colony counts for that SMP Site. Partial counts or within-site plot counts are excluded from the primary MasterSite > Site composition.
hierarchy.merged_record_rule: Records flagged as totals after merging sites/components are excluded unless the exported record resolves to one persistent SMP SiteCode without double counting.

compatibility_rules: Colony-count records only; breeding-success records are excluded.
Primary macro route is MasterSite > SMP Site using Whole Colony counts only.
A primary panel uses one census unit within species (e.g. AON, AOS, AOT or IND) and does not mix units through time.
A primary panel uses one method family through time; method changes require an explicit documented equivalence rule frozen before count magnitudes are opened.

Estimated/hidden-estimate records are retained only if their status is explicitly represented in a later observation model; otherwise primary eligibility uses ACC records and estimate-containing panels are robustness-only.
SMP SiteCode, not display name, is the component identity wherever available.
MasterSite membership changes, SiteCode split/merge events, and parent reassignment are structural flags and cannot be repaired using count magnitudes.

primary_structural_gate.complete_season_definition: all frozen components in the panel have an eligible colony-count record in that season

coverage_audit_outputs_allowed: eligible years and calendar span per panel

decision.pass: All three macro-route minima are met: >=20 candidate panels, >=5 species and >=15 master sites.
decision.marginal: At least 8 panels but the full macro-route minima are not met; SMP may support a focused multispecies validation but not the planned macroecological synthesis.
decision.fail: <8 structurally eligible panels or longitudinal component identity cannot be defended.

post_gate_if_pass: Freeze the count-processing and observation-error model.
Freeze decline/increase eligibility rules without inspecting SMP effect sizes.
Freeze null-calibrated contraction metric and trait hypotheses.
interpretation_boundary: This audit evaluates data structure only, not whether the penguin-derived rule is supported.
Public SMP guidance explicitly values consistent plot names and repeatable site boundaries, but each empirical panel still requires a longitudinal identity audit.
No result from the existing penguin trajectories may be used to tune SMP eligibility after this contract.

external_structural_support.NatureScot_2025: Defines SMP Master site as grouping monitoring sites; defines SMP Site as a long-term monitoring section established for constancy/comparability across years, with a unique numeric code; export fields include SMP_SiteCode, SMP_SiteName, SMP_MasterSite, SMP_PlotName, Method, Count_unit, Accuracy.
external_structural_support.Searle_et_al_2022: Uses SMP Sites nested within Master Sites and aggregates Sites to Master Sites only in years with complete child-site coverage to represent biological populations.
